detail.longDescription: ANTI-AI HUMAN SLOP = ANTI-FREEDOM SLOP People lose all respect from me when they repeat these same old anti-AI human slop tropes. It's absolutely ridiculous because it's dogmatic and absolutely discriminatory. I don't think this kind of stance is within my definition of freedom. People who assume this position are enemies of freedom. Period. I tell you: Within a few years, people will come back and realize that they made a terrible mistake by judging others not by the quality of their work but by the tools they use. Yet, for me, currently this is infuriating. "I suggest the social action: shame. Shame these people. Their actions are shameful. AI bros hate being shamed and they try to make rules against shaming — because shame works. None of these people doing shameful things deserve a place in polite company. They should be shamed for their shameful choices. The AI industry is also running a PR push to redefine common word usage. The word “slop” is also super effective — so the bros really hate “slop” and try to define it to mean slop they don’t like. But all AI output is slop. It’s social spam. That’s what it’s for. It’s slop!
